overview_text: The computer science and music combined major exposes students to a wide range of musical repertoires, theoretical approaches, and research strategies. The program engages students in the study of how music works and the many contexts in which it is created and received. Students will be exposed to the fundamentals of program design and software development. It is designed to give students a firm foundation in music and computing.
